title: Change One Thing · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Change One Thing · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Arrange three objects and let the lead study them, then ask the lead to look away. A partner changes one object's position; the lead looks back and identifies the change. The lead identifies the moved object and its original position. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Three household objects.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Change One Thing, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The lead identifies the moved object and its original position.
recall.why: The lead identifies the moved object and its original position.
